subject: Chase — Vale of Glamorgan FOI 00210772 internal review — 15 October 2026
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear FOI Unit,

This is the scheduled chase for internal review of FOI 00210772, requested on 7 July 2026 and still outstanding.

Please confirm the review outcome or a firm date. I am also concerned that records relevant to Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, Llandough (1988 eviction, demolition, planning and Building Preservation Notice files) may be subject to routine disposal. Please suspend any disposal of those records pending the outcome of this review.

Public working evidence catalogue: https://greathousefarmwiki.wordpress.com
Title and chronology index: https://dartboard.bucklerfamily.estate and https://bpvsbuckler.bucklerfamily.estate
Long-term archive: https://wayback.bucklerfamily.estate

Yours sincerely,

Requester
